marketing_description: The DeWALT® DCN930P1 framing nailer delivers cordless convenience with a 20‑V MAX XR® Lithium‑Ion 5 Ah battery and a brushless motor, allowing up to 530 sq‑ft of framing per charge. Its 30‑ga strip magazine set at a 30‑degree angle and lock‑off trigger provide consistent performance for up to 100 ft of wall framing per charge. The 17.63‑in overall length, 17.07‑in width, and 7‑in depth make it a compact, efficient tool for professional framing tasks.
